story: Kshethram draws from the visual grammar of South Indian sacred architecture—pillar forms, crowned pediments, layered bases, and painted motifs—translating them into a freestanding display unit that feels rooted, stately, and deeply evocative. Two substantial cylindrical pillars define the front elevation, while the architectural crest above gives the piece the presence of a miniature sanctum façade.
tagline: A shrine-like shelf for objects that deserve presence.
name: Kshethram
